Network Infrastructure Specialist | Business Consultant | CCIE Service Provider #38999

With over two decades of distinguished experience in enterprise network infrastructure and telecommunications, I bring a unique combination of deep technical expertise and strategic business acumen to every engagement. As a certified CCIE Service Provider (#38999), I have architected, implemented, and optimized mission-critical network solutions for Fortune 500 companies, global telecommunications operators, and enterprises across multiple continents.

Following my extensive tenure at Aircel Ltd. as Assistant Manager of NOC IP/MPLS Core & Managed Services, I transitioned into entrepreneurship, leveraging my technical foundation to provide comprehensive business consulting and network infrastructure advisory services. My journey from hands-on network engineering to strategic business leadership positions me uniquely to understand both the technical intricacies and business implications of infrastructure decisions.

Today, as a business consultant and entrepreneur, I help organizations navigate the complex landscape of digital transformation, network modernization, and IT infrastructure optimization. My approach combines technical depth with business strategy, ensuring that technology investments align with organizational goals and deliver measurable ROI.

Specializing in designing and implementing high-availability MPLS networks, data center interconnects, and carrier-grade infrastructure that powers telecommunications operators and enterprise networks worldwide. Expert in BGP routing policies, MPLS VPN architectures, and multi-vendor integration scenarios.

Advising organizations on infrastructure strategy, technology roadmaps, vendor selection, and digital transformation initiatives. Bridging the gap between technical capabilities and business objectives to drive informed decision-making and successful outcomes.

Deep experience in provisioning and managing complex enterprise connectivity solutions including MPLS VPNs, dedicated internet access, SD-WAN integration, and hybrid cloud connectivity. Expert in SLA management, performance optimization, and customer-centric service delivery.

What sets me apart is the rare combination of hands-on technical mastery at the CCIE level with real-world experience managing large-scale carrier networks and enterprise managed services operations. I understand not just how to configure networks, but how to architect solutions that align with business objectives, scale efficiently, and deliver measurable value.

My transition from technical specialist to business consultant has equipped me with a holistic perspective that encompasses technical feasibility, operational sustainability, financial viability, and strategic alignment. I speak both the language of the data center and the boardroom, enabling me to bridge gaps that often hinder successful technology initiatives.

Whether you need strategic guidance on infrastructure modernization, hands-on expertise for complex network implementations, or a trusted advisor to navigate vendor landscapes and technology decisions, I bring proven experience, vendor-neutral perspective, and a commitment to delivering outcomes that drive business success.

I'm available for consulting engagements, advisory roles, and strategic partnerships. Whether you're facing network infrastructure challenges, planning a major technology initiative, or seeking expert guidance on enterprise architecture decisions, I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience can help achieve your objectives.

At Longeval Networks , we are committed to delivering high-quality refurbished network solutions and services. This Return & Refund Policy outlines the terms under which returns and refunds are accepted.

Products are eligible for return only if they are found to be defective, damaged during delivery, or not as per the confirmed order specifications. All return requests must be raised within 7 days of delivery.
Customized orders, special configurations, software licenses, and products damaged due to improper handling or misuse are not eligible for return or refund.
Returned products must be unused, in original condition, and include all accessories, documentation, and original packaging. Products returned in damaged or incomplete condition may not be accepted.

To initiate a return, customers must contact Longeval Networks support with order details, reason for return, and relevant images or documentation. Returns without prior approval will not be accepted.
Once the returned product is received and inspected, refunds will be processed if the return is approved. Approved refunds will be issued to the original payment method within 7–10 business days .
Shipping and handling charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to a defect or an error from our side. Return shipping costs may be borne by the customer unless otherwise specified.
Refunds for rented equipment are governed by the specific rental agreement. Early returns, damages, or misuse may result in partial or no refund as per the agreed rental terms.
In certain cases, Longeval Networks may offer a replacement instead of a refund, subject to product availability and inspection results.
Order cancellations are accepted only before dispatch. Once the order has been shipped, cancellation requests will be treated as return requests and handled accordingly.
Longeval Networks reserves the right to modify or update this Return & Refund Policy at any time without prior notice. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on the website.
For any questions regarding returns or refunds, please contact our support team through our official website or customer service channels.
